detail.longDescription: My working through Crafting Interpreters in Zig is continuing at what some might call glacial pace. I've just implemented the first bit of semantic analysis: a resolver that binds identifiers in expressions to the scopes in which those identifiers should be resolved. This is pretty tricky stuff that I never had to think about before trying to implement an interpreter. https:// codeberg.org/hgrsd/lokz/src/br anch/main/src/Resolver.zig # zig # interpreter # opensource # programming # noAI
